content.short: Coinbase NFT API provides near-instant access to NFT data for over 106 million tokens on Ethereum.
content.description: Introduced in 2022 by Coinbase, the NFT API delivers near-instant access to NFT data, empowering developers to build decentralized applications (dApps). It sources data for over 106 million ERC721 and ERC1155 tokens, as well as non-standard NFTs, by aggregating and indexing NFT information. With this API, developers can rapidly create NFT marketplaces, galleries, and wallets with only a few lines of code, streamlining data access for NFT-focused experiences.
